classification: Exploratory extension: historical Time-IMM and Fidel test results already viewed; no untouched-test claim

timeimm.entities: All released local entities; no entity selection by outcome
timeimm.windows: All numeric-adapter retained windows, same 60/20/20 chronological entity split
timeimm.content_cap_rule: Latest four texts strictly within historical window; all event counts and latest age available separately
timeimm.pooling: Modern encoders: attention-mask token mean then L2-normalization; FinBERT classifier head excluded, not claimed as sentence-trained
timeimm.independent_model: Last numeric observation plus independent standardized ridge residual; numeric last/mean/std/count/age, forecast horizon/horizon squared, event count/recency; content = latest4 mean projected onto 32 train-fitted PCA components
timeimm.selection: Validation scalar MSE only, each retrained condition separately; no test selection
timeimm.neutral: Only modern encoders; A report is available. No task-specific information is provided.
timeimm.semantic_derangement: One seeded nonzero circular content permutation over selected text slots within each entity and split; timestamps/counts unchanged; report raw duplicate replacements
timeimm.endpoints: Observed scalar target MSE/MAE, entity macro MSE, per-entity/time records; descriptive effects; no overlap-window independence or p-value claims
timeimm.runtime: CPU; encoder frozen and eval; no downloaded repository code executed

fidel.task: Regular hourly solar generation; 360h history, next24h forecast, 24h stride
fidel.availability: New independent model uses latest weather report at or before numeric forecast cutoff ONLY, never per-future-query reports; report time assumed availability, issuance/arrival metadata unavailable
fidel.representation: Existing published 7x256 weather embeddings, mean over seven slots; no raw-text modern re-encoding claim
fidel.model: Independent standardized multi-output ridge; persistence residual; numeric last24h/previous24h/previous7day hour-means and std, annual sine/cos; pooled historical weather train-only PCA32
fidel.selection: Validation MSE only; no test-informed tuning
fidel.endpoints: All 24 scalar hour errors per window; plant/time records; descriptive plant-macro and scalar MSE
